name: Cable Drag Curl
steps: Face a low cable and hold its bar palms up against the fronts of your thighs.
Draw your elbows behind your waist as you bend them, sliding the bar upward close to your torso.
Straighten your elbows and let the bar follow the same close path down.
tips: Keep your shoulders from shrugging as the bar rises.
Avoid swinging your torso backward to help lift the bar.
